messages:
olga: Kicking off a staggered canary for inference-service v3.2.1 now (change window +30m). Starting at 5% -> planning 5->20->50. Requesting stop/go call from ops/product. @deploy-bot you've got the stage?

deploy-bot: deploy job created by olga. job=canary-rollout inference-service v3.2.1. phase=1 traffic=5%. monitors=latency,p99,error-rate. docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollouts

sam: seeing a tiny uptick on p95 in the initial shard (p95 220ms -> 290ms). not huge but noted.

qa-bot: quick smoke: 10 sample prompts, structured output ok, no obvious misformats. pass/10.

juan: getting a small error bump on edge-12 (0.1% -> 0.6%). stack shows "kv cache miss / retry" in a few traces. not sure if it's systemic.

elaine: thanks juan. could be kv cache warmup. we just pushed warmup tuning to dedicated pool before the roll — might be interacting. recommend HOLD at 10% until we confirm tail latency and cache behavior.

michael: ops +1 to hold. propose hard rollback trigger: error-rate >= 1% sustained for 2m OR p95 >= 450ms. if either hit, auto rollback.

olga: agreed. pausing progression. do not move to 20%. pinning traffic at current ~9% to be safe. creating a ticket to triage kv warmup.

deploy-bot: traffic progression paused. current_traffic=9.3% target_next=20% blocked_by=manual-hold. pinned_version=v3.2.1@canary.

sam: grabbing a few trace samples and heatmap now. will post short summary in 5m.

juan: adding logs from edge-12: ```
[2026-04-03T12:02:14Z] inference svc: kv cache miss -> fetch -> 2nd attempt success
[2026-04-03T12:02:14Z] retry latency 180ms
```

elaine: note: warmup script ran only on 60% of nodes due to a labeling hiccup. fixing labels and re-running warmup should reduce those misses.

olga: plan: 1) hold rollout 2) patch warmup labels 3) re-run warmup on affected pools 4) re-evaluate metrics in 15-20m. if stable, continue to 20%. if errors persist, rollback to v3.2.0.

michael: ack. I'll set the rollback policy in the console and monitor. sending a heads-up to support for any user-facing tickets.

sam: heatmap + traces look better after label fix on one pool — p95 back to ~230ms in that zone. global still slightly elevated due to a few hot shards.

olga: thanks. re-eval at +18m. for now this is a HOLD (stop). if anyone objects, speak now. :thumbsup: for proceed later.

elaine: lgtm to hold, will follow up once warmup completes.

juan: will continue logging and share a short digest.

deploy-bot: note: manual pin applied. rollback-on-thresholds set: error-rate>=1%, p95>=450ms.

olga: created ENG-1942 to track triage + follow-up. re-open thread at +18m for go/no-go. thanks all.
